_doc: Milford's real asphalt edges on six stretches from the 2017 lidar (edges_curves.py). u in metres off the lap line (data/centerline.local.json, the build's swept line), + = left of travel; width = left - right; centre = (left + right) / 2; toward_inside = the centre's offset toward the curve's inside (by the line's own curvature, + = left turn). Built width = the line file's widths_m (the ribbon is +-w/2 about the line). Measured unless marked [invented] / [model].

read.keep: within the built lane edge + 5.0 m

registration.alt_source: ledger 0087's NAIP - lidar fit of the pavement edges (source/edges/edge_evidence.json registration.naip_minus_lidar_m, lap-wide): the frame the line was traced in. Moves a centre by (alt - shift) . n; widths unchanged
registration.naip_outward_doc: the same fit's mean outward difference: NAIP's edge 0.257 m further out per side than the lidar's intensity step, so NAIP reads ~0.51 m wider; which reads the true edge was left unresolved (ledger 0087)

width.steady_rule: [invented] steady unless 3 or more consecutive 5 m bins sit off the real width's straight line by more than 2 x their own noise, on the same side
